title: Flow result pane: scanline + latent vanish after stepping away from Generate mid-run
description: Fabio 2026-10-12: mid-run, step back to Inputs and forward to Generate - the pane shows 'Your result appears here.', no scanline, no latent, until the next sampler frame (minutes on 360 Panorama). Root cause: _buildRunSlide rebuilds the frame; scanline is armed only by _syncRunning/_paintResult and the held latent seeded only in _track, so a rebuild while _running re-arms neither. Fix: re-arm both in _buildRunSlide when _running.
